action.quote: one organization must be assigned the responsibility of alerting the public as soon as word of the accidental release is received. Delay in alerting the public can lead to the loss of life.

by_when.quote: as soon as word of the accidental release is received

alert_public.when: people live or work inside the footprint
alert_public.who: one organization must be assigned the responsibility of alerting the public

action.quote: Begin evacuating people nearby and those who are outdoors in direct view of the scene. When additional help arrives, expand the area to be evacuated downwind and crosswind to at least the extent recommended in this guidebook.

begin_evacuating.when: people live or work inside the footprint

action.quote: Initiate protective actions beginning with those closest to the spill site and working away in a downwind direction.

closest_first.when: the footprint holds a protective action zone (a Table 1 material)

action.quote: Send evacuees to a definite place, by a specific route, far enough away so they will not have to relocate again if the wind shifts.

definite_place.when: people live or work inside the footprint

indoors.when: people live or work inside the footprint

action.quote: Each institutional facility (such as hospitals, schools, day care centers, correctional facilities, assisted living facilities or nursing homes) in the community should be considered separately to determine what special protective actions may be necessary.

institutions.when: a school, hospital, nursing home or group quarters lies inside the footprint

action.quote: Isolate hazard area and deny entry means to keep everybody away from the area if they are not directly involved in emergency response operations. Unprotected emergency responders should not be allowed to enter the isolation zone.

by_when.quote: This is the first step for any protective actions that may follow.

action.quote: A NWEM is a nonscheduled product and will be relayed at the request of alerting authorities over NWS dissemination systems.

nws_relay.when: people live or work inside the footprint
nws_relay.who: at the request of alerting authorities

outdoors.when: people live or work inside the footprint

action.quote: If schools are located in the risk zone, the plan must identify the location to which students will be moved in an evacuation and how parents will be notified of this location.

schools.when: a school lies inside the footprint

action.quote: Several analyses suggest that it will take 5 to 10 minutes on average to implement shelter-in-place, once a sheltering decision is made by a household.

by_when.quote: 5 to 10 minutes on average to implement shelter-in-place, once a sheltering decision is made by a household

shelter_time.when: people live or work inside the footprint

action.quote: It is vital for first responders to maintain communications with sheltered-in-place people so that they are advised about changing conditions.

sheltered_communications.when: people live or work inside the footprint

action.quote: Special attention must also be paid to evacuating hospitals, nursing homes, and homes for the physically or mentally disabled.

special_attention.when: a hospital or nursing home lies inside the footprint

action.quote: Provisions must be made for quickly moving traffic out of the risk zone and also for preventing outside traffic from entering the risk zone.

traffic.when: a road crosses the footprint (the load is on a highway, or the footprint holds grade crossings)

action.quote: The SIP warning should be disseminated without delay using a variety of means- reverse 911 on landlines, text messages to cell phones in the area, PA broadcast, police car PA systems, etc.

warning_means.when: people live or work inside the footprint

action.quote: once a decision is made to protect the public, a considerable amount of time (up to one to two hours using conventional warning practices) may elapse before most people in the affected area hear, absorb, and decide to respond to the instructions

by_when.quote: up to one to two hours using conventional warning practices

warning_time.when: people live or work inside the footprint

data.demonstration: A demonstration, not a protocol: no incident commander has reviewed this table.
data.label: Suggested actions to consider
data.no_entry: No held source gives an action for this.
uncovered: the material was spilled in water and ERG Table 2 lists it (material_response_guidance: table2_note)
a waterway crosses the footprint (facilities_in_footprint: counts.waterways)
a rail line crosses the footprint (facilities_in_footprint: counts.rail_segments)
the wind the footprint is oriented by was stated by the caller, not forecast or observed (protective_action_footprint: wind.origin)
the material is not identified, or the ERG lists it under several entries (assess_incident: error, or several candidates)
